name: Name
name_help: A human-readable label for this assistant
project_immutable_tooltip: Project cannot be changed after creation
secret_token_immutable_tooltip: Secret token is auto-generated and immutable
secret_token_help: This token identifies your assistant. Include it in the embed URL.
enable_confirm_description: This will make the AI assistant available on the host page.
disable_confirm_description: This will take the AI assistant offline. Existing chat sessions will be interrupted.
confirm_delete_description: This will permanently delete this AI assistant, its knowledge base, and all chat history. This action cannot be undone.
config_section_ai_assistant_empty: No AI assistant configured for this project yet.
config_section_no_project: Select a project to manage AI assistant.
allowed_origins_help: Domains allowed to embed this assistant. Leave empty for unrestricted.
allowed_origins_empty_warning: No origin restrictions — the assistant can be embedded from any domain.
snippet_description: Copy this snippet and paste it into your website's HTML before the closing </body> tag.
snippet_help: The script loads the AI assistant widget on your website. The data-lang attribute sets the default language — the landing page can override it via JavaScript.
snippet_language_override: Language can be overridden from the landing page via JavaScript. See the API documentation for details.
api_key_help: Your API key for the AI provider. Encrypted at rest.
api_key_current: Current key is set. Leave blank to keep it.
base_prompt_help: Instructions that define the assistant's behavior and personality
base_prompt_placeholder: You are a helpful customer support assistant for...
preset_confirm_delete: Delete this preset? This cannot be undone.
display_name_help: Name shown in the chat widget header
legal_message_help: Disclaimer or legal notice shown before the greeting message when a chat starts
legal_message_placeholder: e.g. This conversation may be recorded for quality purposes...
greeting_message_help: First message the assistant sends when a chat starts
greeting_message_placeholder: Hello! How can I help you today?
avatar_url_help: Optional custom avatar image URL for the widget
rate_limit_burst_help: Max messages per IP per minute
rate_limit_sustained_help: Max messages per IP per day
max_upload_size_help: Maximum file size for knowledge base documents
default_language_help: Initial language for the widget. The landing page can override this via JavaScript.
supported_languages_help: Languages this assistant has UI translations for. The landing page can switch the widget language via JavaScript.
translations_help: Customize the display name, greeting, and placeholder text per language. These are the UI texts the widget shows.
knowledge_base_description: Upload documents to give your AI assistant context. Supported formats: PDF, TXT, Markdown, DOCX, CSV. The knowledge base is language-agnostic — the AI searches all documents regardless of language.
delete_document_confirm: Delete this document and all its chunks? This cannot be undone.
file_too_large: File exceeds the maximum upload size of {{maxSize}}MB.
invalid_file_type: Unsupported file type. Please upload PDF, TXT, Markdown, DOCX, or CSV.
popup_message_placeholder: A message shown in a bubble from the chat button when the page loads...
popup_message_help: Optional message bubble that appears from the FAB button when the page loads. Disappears when the assistant is opened. Only shown once per page load.
